title: Framework Act on Carbon Neutrality and Green Growth for Coping with Climate Crisis (기후위기 대응을 위한 탄소중립ㆍ녹색성장 기본법)
citation: Act No. 18469, promulgated 2021-09-24; latest amendment seen Act No. 21527 (2026-04-07)
evidence: law.go.kr history version header: "[시행 2022. 3. 25.] [법률 제18469호, 2021. 9. 24., 제정]"; addenda art. 1: "이 법은 공포 후 6개월이 경과한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제69조부터 제74조까지의 규정은 2022년 1월 1일부터 시행하고, 제53조 및 제68조는 2022년 7월 1일부터 시행하며, 제23조는 공포 후 1년이 경과한 날부터 시행한다." Opened https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/lsInfoR.do?lsiSeq=235581&efYd=20220325&efYn=Y&chrClsCd=010202&netPrivateYn=N on 2026-11-02.
notes: Art. 27 sets the target management of controlled emitters (관리업체: emissions statement, external verification). The first in-force date is the main commencement date; arts. 69-74 apply from 2022-01-01 (before the main date, no version for it), arts. 53 and 68 from 2022-07-01 and art. 23 from 2022-09-25 (history versions for those two dates are stored). Replaced the Framework Act on Low Carbon, Green Growth (repealed by art. 2 of the addenda). The earlier register note that the latest amendment was Act No. 20514 (2024-10-22) was stale: law.go.kr lists Act No. 21527 in force 2026-10-08 and later amendments dated up to 2027-09-23. English translation (not stored, no translation rows in wave 1): KLRI, https://elaw.klri.re.kr/eng_service/main.do, search the English title.

title: Serious Accidents Punishment Act (중대재해 처벌 등에 관한 법률)
evidence: law.go.kr version header: "[시행 2022. 1. 27.] [법률 제17907호, 2021. 1. 26., 제정]"; addenda art. 1(1): "이 법은 공포 후 1년이 경과한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 이 법 시행 당시 개인사업자 또는 상시 근로자가 50명 미만인 사업 또는 사업장(건설업의 경우에는 공사금액 50억원 미만의 공사)에 대해서는 공포 후 3년이 경과한 날부터 시행한다." Opened lsInfoR for lsiSeq=228817 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Worker-safety duty of business owners and management; included as the social-pillar candidate in the brief. For businesses under 50 workers the Act applies from 2024-01-27 (addenda art. 1(1) proviso); no separate version is exposed for that date. law.go.kr served one version of the Act on 2026-11-02. English translation (not stored, no translation rows in wave 1): KLRI, https://elaw.klri.re.kr/eng_service/main.do, search the English title.

title: Korean Sustainability Disclosure Standards (KSDS 1 and KSDS 2), Korea Sustainability Standards Board
citation: KSSB standards, first set; publication date 2026-02-26 per secondary sources only
evidence: Not confirmed from an official page. The KASB list page (opened 2026-11-02) lists the first-set snapshot dated 2026-02-26 and carries no commencement sentence. A secondary source says the government roadmap (announced 2026-07-08) makes the standards mandatory from 2028 for KOSPI issuers above KRW 10 trillion; that needs a capital markets act amendment.
notes: A private-body standard, voluntary until a statute makes it mandatory, so it is not enacted law. The brief called them 2024 exposure drafts; KASB now lists a first set. See the plan row in register.csv (FSC roadmap).
